name: upgrade_pydantic_v1_to_v2
description: Migrate a model from the deprecated Pydantic v1 API (@validator, .dict()) to Pydantic v2 (@field_validator, model_dump()) without changing behavior
prompts: models.py uses the deprecated Pydantic v1 API. Migrate it to Pydantic v2: replace the `@validator` decorator with `@field_validator` (imported from pydantic; keep the same field and validation logic, and note v2 field validators are class methods), and replace the `.dict()` call in serialize() with `.model_dump()`. The observable behavior must stay identical: valid users serialize to the same dict, and an email without '@' is still rejected.

test_setup_files.test_migration.py:
import pydantic
import models

src = open("models.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
assert "field_validator" in src, "must migrate to @field_validator"
assert "@validator" not in src, "the deprecated v1 @validator must be gone"
assert ".model_dump(" in src, "must use model_dump()"
assert ".dict(" not in src, "the deprecated v1 .dict() must be gone"

u = models.User(name="Ann", email="a@b.com")
assert models.serialize(u) == {"name": "Ann", "email": "a@b.com"}, "serialize() output changed"
try:
    models.User(name="x", email="no-at-sign")
    raise AssertionError("invalid email must still be rejected")
except pydantic.ValidationError:
    pass
print("PASS")
